questions.q: What does the thermometer show, according to Andrija?
questions.e: In the video: "imaš 37 i 4" — you have 37.4.

questions.q: What kind of thermometer does she demand?
questions.e: In the video: "Donesi mi toplomer koji mi pokazuje 42 i 9 ili 39 i 4, nebitno." — bring me a thermometer that shows 42.9 or 39.4, doesn't matter.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ja sam ovde mrtva *bolesna*, a ti mi donosiš toplomer sa 37.
Nemoj da mi ___ ovaj toplomer koji mi pokazuje 37.
questions.e: Nemoj da + present tense 2nd pers. sg.: nemoj da donosiš — "don't bring".

questions.q: Donesi mi toplomer koji mi ___ 42 i 9.
questions.e: The subject is toplomer (3rd pers. sg.): pokazuje.
